cities.reason: Postal name for Arlington County, which by law has no cities or towns within it; the county's business license (BPOL) and business tangible personal property return are already seeded in data/counties/VA.json.

counties.reason: Planning region (council of governments area), not a county government; Connecticut's counties have no government of their own, and business filings go to towns.
